# Book Report

As described in the seminal work on typography[^bringhurst], good design
principles are essential for readability.

The history of printing[^meggs] provides important context for understanding
modern document design.

## Bibliography

[^bringhurst]: Bringhurst, R. (2012). The Elements of Typographic Style (4th ed.). Hartley and Marks.

[^meggs]: Meggs, P. B., & Purvis, A. W. (2016). Meggs' History of Graphic Design (6th ed.). Wiley.
